intro: Extract requested profile, tasks, time and time of application in an offer. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Extract requested profile, tasks, time and time of application in an offer. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
